get.summary: Fetch social media posts
get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of social media posts for a specific workspace with filtering options

parameters.name: status[]
parameters.description: Filter by post status using array notation. Example: status[]=draft&status[]=scheduled&status[]=published. Use `notification_sent` / `notification_declined` for mobile push-notification publishing flow, and `processing` for posts currently being published.

parameters.name: approval_assigned_to[]
parameters.description: Filter by approver user IDs. Returns posts where these users are assigned as approvers.

parameters.name: approval_requested_by[]
parameters.description: Filter by users who requested approval. Returns posts submitted for review by these users.

parameters.name: content_category[]
parameters.description: Filter posts by content category IDs.

parameters.name: created_by[]
parameters.description: Filter posts by the user IDs who created them.

parameters.name: comment_status
parameters.description: Filter posts by comment resolution status. `all` (default) returns all posts regardless of comment state.

post_url.description: Deep link to the post in the planner list view. Null when no whitelabel/workspace slug is resolvable.

text.example: Check out our latest product launch!

posting_status.description: Result of the publishing attempt for this account. Present only once a posting record exists.

post_link.description: Live URL of the published post. Present when posting_status is success.

error_message.description: Failure reason. Present when posting_status is error.

deleted.description: True when the published post was later deleted on the platform.

execute_time.description: Resolved execution time of the post. Null when no execution time is set.

content_category_id.description: Empty string when the post is not tied to a content category.

campaign.description: Campaign/folder information. Empty object {} when no campaign assigned.

first_comment.description: First comment payload. Empty object {} when not configured.

message.example: Don't forget to check our website!

gmb_options.description: Google My Business options. Empty object {} when no GMB account is targeted.

youtube_options.description: YouTube options. Empty object {} when no YouTube account is targeted. Note: category is returned as the stored YouTube category ID, not the name accepted on the store endpoint.

tiktok_options.description: TikTok options. Empty object {} when no TikTok account is targeted.

pinterest_options.description: Pinterest title and destination link. Empty object {} when no Pinterest account is targeted.

twitter_options.description: Twitter/X thread options. Empty object {} when no Twitter account is targeted or threads are disabled.

threads_options.description: Threads multi-thread options. Empty object {} when no Threads account is targeted or multi-threads are disabled.

facebook_options.description: Facebook options. Empty object {} when no Facebook account is targeted.

facebook_background_id.description: Empty string when no text-post background preset is selected.

carousel.description: Carousel payload reshaped to the store-request format. Empty array [] when the post is not a carousel.

approval.description: Approval information. Empty object {} when no approval is set.

external_actions.description: External action participants. Each item only exposes the external user's name and email.

external_comments.description: External comments with minimal comment metadata.

post.summary: Create a new social media post
post.description: Create a new social media post with simplified payload structure

text.example: Check out our latest product launch!

media_ids.description: Array of media library IDs (from GET /media endpoint). Media already in the library will be used directly without re-uploading. Can be combined with images/video URLs.

accounts.description: Array of account IDs to post to (platform will be automatically detected). Optional if content_category_id is provided.

content_category_id.description: Optional content category ID. When provided, accounts from the category will be used. Can be combined with accounts array for merged unique accounts.

post_type.description: Optional post type. See docs for platform-specific supported values. Defaults to 'feed' when omitted. For Facebook carousel posts you may set post_type='carousel', but you MUST also provide facebook_options.carousel.is_carousel_post=true with at least 2 cards — otherwise it is rejected with 400.

post_video_title.description: Optional video title for platforms that support it (YouTube, LinkedIn). Will be set in common_sharing_details video title, YouTube options, and LinkedIn options.

hide_client.description: Optional. When true, hides draft posts from client users. Ignored and stored as false for non-draft posts.

first_comment.description: Optional first comment for the post

message.example: Great product! Check the details in comments.

accounts.description: Account IDs for first comment (must be subset of main accounts)

gmb_options.description: Optional Google Business Profile specific options

media.description: Media URLs or media library IDs. Twitter/X allows multiple images or one video only.
Media URLs or media library IDs. Threads allows mixed images and videos in the same item.

pinterest_options.description: Optional Pinterest specific options (saved to sharing details)

facebook_background_id.description: Facebook text-format preset ID for colored-background text posts. Only applies to plain text posts — the request is rejected if media (images, video, or media_ids) is also provided. Use GET /api/v1/facebook/text-backgrounds to list valid preset IDs.

collaborators.description: Facebook Reel collaborators to invite. Each item is a Facebook Page identifier — a numeric Page ID (recommended), an @username, or a Page URL (resolved to a Page ID at publish time). Applies only to Reels published to Facebook Pages; personal profiles are not valid collaborators. Facebook allows up to 10 invites per Page per 24 hours.

carousel.description: Optional Facebook carousel post. When enabled, the post is published as a multi-card carousel on the selected Facebook Pages instead of a regular feed post. Carousel is image-only — video is not allowed. If `content.media.images` is empty, card images are auto-mirrored so non-Facebook accounts in the same post still receive images.

is_carousel_post.description: Set true to publish as carousel.

cards.description: Between 2 and 10 carousel cards. Required when is_carousel_post is true.

image.description: Card image URL. External URLs are uploaded to the media library; library URLs are used as-is.

description.example: Short description shown under the title.

link.description: Destination URL when the card is tapped.

accounts.description: Optional subset of `accounts[]` (workspace account IDs) to publish as carousel. Only Facebook accounts in this subset will use carousel mode; other Facebook accounts in `accounts[]` will publish normally. Omit to apply carousel to ALL Facebook accounts in the post.

call_to_action.description: CTA button shown on every card. Maps to Facebook Graph `child_attachments.call_to_action.type`.

end_card.description: Include a Facebook end card after the last card.

end_card_url.description: Destination URL for the end card. Falls back to the first card's link when omitted.

collaborators.description: Instagram collaborators (co-authors) to invite by username. Up to 3. Only public Instagram profiles connected via Facebook can be added; not applicable to Story posts.

labels.description: Optional array of label IDs to attach to the post. Maximum 20 labels. Must be valid label IDs for the workspace.

campaign_id.description: Optional campaign (folder) ID to assign the post to. Must be a valid campaign ID for the workspace.

approval.description: Optional approval workflow. When provided, the post is sent for review before publishing.

approvers.description: Array of user IDs who can approve the post. Must be workspace team members and cannot include the post creator.

approve_option.description: Whether any single approver or all approvers must approve

account_ids.description: Platform account IDs to target. Omit to target all published accounts.
